explicit_validation.explanation: Paper explicitly compares LLM evaluations with human judgments through pairwise preference consistency analysis and correlation analysis, reporting quantitative alignment metrics

prompts.notes: Prompt structure described with criteria (helpfulness, relevance, accuracy, comprehensiveness) but exact template shown only partially in text

guidelines.notes: Detailed instructions provided for human evaluation criteria (helpfulness, relevance, accuracy, comprehensiveness) and pairwise comparison process

sample_size.notes: Human evaluation conducted on randomly selected 140 audio dialogues, same as those evaluated by LLMs

validation_results.summary_finding: GPT-4 evaluator demonstrates significantly higher correlation with human evaluations, with pairwise preference consistency above 85%, validating strong alignment between LLM and human judgments.

criteria_mapping.notes: Both LLM and human evaluation use identical criteria of helpfulness, relevance, accuracy, and comprehensiveness for scoring
